I underwent Panchkarma treatment at this clinic last week, and my overall experience was very disappointing.

The bathroom was not clean, which is an essential part of hygiene in any clinic.
I was told that the therapy session would last one and a half hours. However, I was out of the treatment room in one hour and fifteen minutes, and this included preparation, cleaning, and changing clothes. The actual massage time was at least fifteen minutes shorter than promised.

When I complained about the reduced time, the doctor mentioned that it would be covered in my next visit, which assumed that I would return.
The treatment bed was very narrow, and it felt unsafe and uncomfortable, especially with severe joint pain. It was difficult and scary to turn onto my back during the session. The potli used during the treatment did not have the usual aroma associated with Ayurvedic medicines, not sure of the reason though.

During the massage, the therapist applied pressure on a point near my elbow where I have severe pain. When I asked her to stop, the massage was not continued properly. She also attempted to remove a skin tag from my back without my consent and without any doctor’s advice. When I objected, she casually said that beauty parlours charge ₹3000 for this and that she was doing it at no extra cost. This felt extremely unprofessional.

When I raised these issues, I was told that the therapist is an “award winner,” though I am not sure which award, and this did not address the concern. During the consultation, the doctor also repeatedly mentioned that many of her relatives take treatment at the clinic, which made me question whether the online five-star reviews reflect genuine patient experiences.

I paid ₹2200 for Panchkarma, ₹300 for consultation, and ₹965 for medicines, but did not experience any relief. Later, when I sought a second opinion for my joint swelling and pain, I was informed that massage and potli therapy are not advisable in such a condition.
Overall, this was an unprofessional and unsatisfactory experience.
